{{Quote|<nowiki>T7 = special assistant to Senator Oodora // Senator Oodora = Manaan representative // T7 = helped Senator Oodora for 20 years</nowiki>|translated=1|T7-O1|<ref name="The Traitor">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|The Traitor}}</ref>}}
'''Oodora''' was a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]<ref name="Holonet" /> for four consecutive terms, serving in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] for over twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] in the [[Time/Legends|decades]] before the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During Oodora's tenure, the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] served the Senator as a legislation analyst, but Oodora promoted T7-O1 after the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] first year and the astromech soon became the Senator's campaign manager and speech writer.<ref name="The Traitor" /> After Oodora retired, T7-O1 eventually passed into the ownership of the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaver]] [[Shafu]].<ref name="Slaver's Redemption">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|Slaver's Redemption}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Oodora was first mentioned in [[the Holonet]] section of the official site for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], in the entry for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] companion character T7-O1.<ref name="Holonet" />
